Name: The Tent (Farmhouse Redux)
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[color=#00ff00][size=6][font=Georgia][b][center]This is real tent life.[/center][/b][/font][/size][/color]Changes to the exterior and interior of the Farmhouse.
It is possible to use only one of them.
Changes to the exterior not only change the appearance, but also the physical size and other data of the farmhouse.
[color=#d5a6bd]The color of the tent can be freely set from the robin's construction menu. (Building Layer)[/color]

[size=5]Note on changing the interior.[/size]
[color=#00ffff][size=3]・The settings for interior changes are disabled by default.[/size][/color]
[size=2]This is because changes to the interior will drastically alter the map, and existing data may leave furniture in unrecoverable locations or make it impossible for characters to move around.[/size]
If you wish to make interior changes with existing data, we recommend that you collect all furniture and activate the settings after leaving the house or install “[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]Noclip Mode[/url]”.
[color=#00ffff][size=3]・When starting new data.[/size][/color]
If you are starting a new game, you will spawn on the outside of the room with your bed on the first morning, but you can walk on the outside and leave the house once you have the bed. After that, once you enter the house, you can play as normal the rest of the day.
In addition, some custom farm map mods may disable the initial placement of furniture, walls, and floors when creating a farm.
In this case, most of the initial furniture will be generated outside the beams, so they must be retrieved and moved out of the house.
You may want to install “[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]Noclip Mode[/url]﻿” to facilitate these collections.
If you find a custom farm map mod that disables the initial placement of furniture, walls and floor settings, we would appreciate it if you would report it in POSTS.
Because we can add compatibility.


Currently available in English and Japanese.

[b][center][color=#00ff00][size=5]Have a good tent life![/size][/color][/center][/b]

You can also try this mod to add a tent as a new building.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23578?tab=description][size=4](CP) Camping tent with tarp[/size][/url]
